title: CertificateIdentityV1
description:
Public certificate identity metadata. Private key material and certificate bytes never cross
this boundary; each certificate is represented by its immutable SHA-256 digest.

endpoint_identity_sha256.description: Endpoint identity digest bound during enrollment.

issuer_sha256.description: Issuer certificate digest, or the trust anchor digest for the root.

not_after.description: Exclusive validity end in Unix seconds.

not_before.description: Inclusive validity start in Unix seconds.

role.description: Least-privilege role bound to this identity.

trust_anchor_sha256.description: Explicit trust anchor digest selected by the runtime.
